title: OpenCode Session Plugin Config
description: Configuration for the Axiom opencode-session OpenCode plugin.

opencode_base_url.description: OpenCode HTTP API base URL. Overrides auto-detection from MCP client.

request_timeout_ms.description: Timeout for OpenCode API HTTP requests (ms).

spawn_timeout_ms.description: Total-runtime watchdog: kills spawned process after N ms if still running. 0 = disabled (no watchdog). For long-running background sessions, set to 0.

message_fetch_limit.description: Maximum number of messages to return per fetchMessages() call. Uses head semantics (slice from oldest). 0 = no client-side limit (return all messages from single API response; API pagination may still apply).

stat_rate_limit_ms.description: Minimum interval between session_stat calls per (caller_id, session_id) (ms). SWDE-66.
